page.title: Developers
page.intro: Call this workspace's models and published agents from your programs and tools (n8n, LibreChat, scripts) with any OpenAI client: change only the address and the key.
page.baseUrlNote: OpenAI-compatible: use it as « base_url » (Python), « baseURL » (TypeScript) or « Base URL » (n8n).
page.authText: Every request carries the « Authorization: Bearer YOUR_KEY » header. Create the key in Settings › API keys: name, expiry, allowed models, monthly cap and rate; its value is shown only once. An expired or revoked key gets a 401 error, a model that is not allowed a 403 error.
page.agentsText: This workspace's published agents (workspace key only):

errorCodes.model_not_allowed: 403, model or agent not allowed for this key
errorCodes.rate_limit_exceeded: 429, too many requests per minute for this key
errorCodes.monthly_cap_reached: 429, the key's monthly token cap is reached
errorCodes.monthly_budget_reached: 402, the workspace's or instance's monthly budget is reached

page.sdk: Nexora SDKs (Python and TypeScript) and examples with the official « openai » client: folders workstudio/packages/python-sdk, workstudio/packages/ts-sdk and docs/exemples/api-openai of the Nexora repository.
